usage: The word 煩 (faan4) is used as an adjective to describe a feeling of being annoyed or bothered.
It can describe situations, people, or internal feelings that cause irritation or stress.
煩 can appear before a noun to describe it, e.g., 煩人 (faan4 jan4) meaning an annoying person.
It is often used in casual speech to express frustration or trouble with something.
煩 can also be paired with verbs or adjectives to intensify the feeling of annoyance.
